svg.title: Run, measure, improve, deploy
svg.desc: The Hylo loop. Run: an experiment becomes a run, every step traced (hylo run). Measure: a fixed protocol scores runs into a scorecard (hylo bench). Improve: a candidate must win a paired gate on episodes it never saw (hylo evolve). Deploy: the promoted version runs on the robot, inside safety limits (hylo serve). Episodes on the robot come back as runs.
